useCases: Vendors submit invoices for procured materials that must be matched to purchase orders and production requirements.
Material receipts from invoices must be recorded in inventory management for production planning accuracy.
Invoice data feeds cost analytics and compliance monitoring for procurement optimization.
Production bill-of-materials must be validated against current engineering standards and material approvals.
Engineering change notices must be cross-referenced with material selections to ensure production uses approved revisions.
Material and component specifications must meet regulatory and quality compliance requirements before manufacturing.
Production orders must be created and scheduled on available manufacturing machines based on capacity and delivery deadlines.
Machine availability and capability must be matched to production order requirements to optimize resource utilization.
Production scheduling must coordinate material availability with machine capacity and workforce availability.
Production workers must be allocated to scheduled production orders based on skill requirements and availability.
Workforce organization structure must be consulted to ensure labor assignments comply with organizational hierarchy and reporting relationships.
Labor allocation decisions feed compensation planning and workforce cost forecasting for budget validation.
